description: Make a film public on its film page. Refused, with the same message the film editor shows, while the publish checklist is incomplete: title, poster, a ready main film, a price only when it is Buy or rent (a free-to-watch film publishes without one), and the creator's rights confirmation. The first time a film is published the user must agree to this statement, which you read to them in full before passing confirm_rights: true: "I confirm I own or hold every right needed to publish and sell this film, including music, footage, performances and releases from people in it. I accept full responsibility for any claim that it infringes someone's rights, as set out in the Terms of Service – Your warranties (/terms#your-warranties)." A film that already carries a confirmation is not asked again. The checklist comes back with how to finish each open item: update_film or start_film_upload where a tool can do it, publish_film with confirm_rights for the rights row, and the editor link for the poster, which is added in the film editor, not through this connection.

confirm_rights.description: The creator's rights confirmation, required the first time a film is published (not asked again once recorded). Pass true only after the user has agreed to this statement, read to them in full: "I confirm I own or hold every right needed to publish and sell this film, including music, footage, performances and releases from people in it. I accept full responsibility for any claim that it infringes someone's rights, as set out in the Terms of Service – Your warranties (/terms#your-warranties)."

film_id.description: The film's public id (from list_films / get_film).
